publication_boundary: The containing final evidence commit adds receipts only. W and S below remain exact; no test result is relabelled as having executed on a later commit.

observation_policy.test_observations: First timed emission of each unique case/verdict/duration. Bun terminal-summary duplicates are retained in repeated_summary_observations and are not additional test cases.
observation_policy.counts: Bun terminal counts cross-checked against unique timed observations for every run. Counts across runs are not summed as coverage.
observation_policy.logs: SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 decoded MCP job-log bytes; local scratch location is not durable evidence. Run/job URLs identify the retained remote source.
observation_policy.reuse: Reuse only at original W/S or with separately demonstrated unchanged dependency closure; a successful selected case never closes every criterion or installed consumer.
observation_policy.omni: All product requests record not applicable. No resident/Omni or installed acceptance is claimed.
